---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability, command, or workflow type
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## What problem does this solve?

A clear description of the problem or limitation you're running into.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. If this is a new CLI command, a new built-in workflow
(alongside git-flow / GitHub Flow / trunk-based), or a change to an existing
domain rule, please say which.

## Which layer does this touch?

- [ ] `domain` (a new rule, policy, or workflow concept)
- [ ] `application` (a new use case / handler)
- [ ] `infrastructure` (a new adapter, e.g. a different `GitRepository` implementation)
- [ ] `cli` (a new or changed command)
- [ ] Not sure

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've thought about.

## Additional context

Anything else — links, examples from other tools, etc.
